'''Vindir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifacts on board [[Carrick Station]].

==Behind the scenes==
Vindir first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a dark side vendor.
